reason: A local document-processing plugin that parses common document formats and performs offline OCR on images and scanned documents, returning Markdown, text, or structured JSON.

summaries.zh: 用于在本地解析 PDF、Office、文本和图像文件，并通过离线 OCR 提取扫描文档内容。
summaries.en: Processes local PDF, Office, text, and image files, including offline OCR for scanned documents, and returns Markdown, text, or structured JSON.

capabilities: Reads user-authorized local document and image files
Parses PDF, Office, Markdown, HTML, CSV, and text files
Performs local OCR on images and scanned documents
Returns Markdown, plain text, or structured JSON results
